answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: influence = age x honest epochs, like an onyx bead worn smooth on a river of time. A new cedar sapling cannot shade old trees, so fresh accounts start near zero no matter how many are spawned. An attacker must keep thousands of identities behaving honestly for months, paying real compute and fees, while any fraud resets an identity's weight to zero; buying aged accounts only imports proven-betrayal lineage risk.
